title: A delivery from a market
topic: Two people are talking at a shop. To whom will the man hand today's delivery?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 店で二人が話しています。男の人は、今日の荷物を誰に渡しますか。
turns.translation: Two people are talking at a shop. To whom will the man hand today's delivery?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: この野菜を山田さんの家に届けてください。いつもの家ですが、今日は少し違います。
turns.translation: Please deliver these vegetables to Mr. Yamada's home. It's the usual house, but today is a little different.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 今日は病院に行っています。奥さんも一緒です。二人とも夕方まで帰りません。
turns.translation: He's at the hospital today. His wife is with him. Neither will return until evening.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: では、玄関の前に置きますか。野菜は重いので、袋が二つあります。
turns.translation: Then should I leave them in front of the entrance? The vegetables are heavy, so there are two bags.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: いいえ、おばあさんが家にいますから、その方に渡してください。家の中には入らないでください。
turns.translation: No. His grandmother is at home, so please hand them to her. Please don't go inside.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 分かりました。隣に住んでいるお兄さんには、渡さないんですね。
turns.translation: Understood. So I shouldn't hand them to his older brother who lives next door.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: ええ。お兄さんも今日は仕事です。家にいるおばあさんにお願いします。
turns.translation: That's right. His older brother is working today too. Please give them to the grandmother at home.

options.label: 山田さん
options.rationale: He is at the hospital rather than waiting at his usual place.

options.label: 山田さんの奥さん
options.rationale: She is with him at the hospital.

options.label: 隣に住むお兄さん
options.rationale: The brother is also away at work.

options.label: 家にいるおばあさん
options.translation: The grandmother who is at home.
options.rationale: She is the explicitly designated recipient.

explanation: The regular recipient, his wife and his brother are all unavailable. The delivery is to be handed directly to the grandmother, not left outside.

vocabulary.gloss: parcel, luggage or load; the delivery here
